model.name: A gate resolves an artifact the SAME WAY the runtime consumer does — ONE shared exported resolver both import, so gated-path and loaded-path CANNOT diverge by construction
model.description: A gate that certifies an ARTIFACT (revoked-list / config / bundle / version file) MUST resolve it via the SAME path/config resolution the RUNTIME consumer uses — NOT a same-named sibling in another dir, NOT a pre-build copy, NOT a default that differs from the deploy/load path. WRONG-ARTIFACT is GREEN-FOREVER: the gate certifies a file the runtime never loads, so it never REDs on its own (unlike staleness, which eventually REDs) — the worst of the gate-honesty classes, and DISTINCT from stale-gate (R37.17) and wrong-SURFACE (gate-the-AC-surface). Live instance = R40.34-L1 (gate checks revoked-token-hashes.json ROOT while the server loads data/revoked-tokens.json DATA_DIR — armed-but-inert). ★ FIX BY CONSTRUCTION (PO-prioritised, not a detector): ONE exported path-resolver (a single-source function) imported by BOTH the gate AND the runtime consumer, so the gated-path and the loaded-path CANNOT diverge — plus a stub-must-fail divergence bite that PROVES the prevention is live. Police-the-output (a detector that notices they disagree) has LOST every time this campaign; a single-source that makes divergence unrepresentable wins.

discoverySource.note: Kill-the-generator over police-the-output: R37.15 killed the naming generator, R37.16 the sibling-credit path, R37.17 snapshot-encoding, the no-flush guard the config-flush chokepoint — each a single-source that made the defect unrepresentable, never a detector. R37.18 applies it to gate/runtime artifact resolution.

model.crossRefNote: Gate/board-honesty by-construction family: R37.13 (no bespoke ids) + R37.15 (no embedded-derived-field names) + R37.16 (no sibling-credited RIPE) + R37.17 (no snapshot-rot gates) + R37.18 (gate resolves the SAME artifact as runtime) + R40.32 (gates self-assert served==committed). R37.18 is the WRONG-ARTIFACT sibling of R37.17's STALE class (staleness eventually REDs; wrong-artifact never does). First application = R40.34-L1 (its unifyLoadPath is the single-resolver instance).

acceptanceCriteria.text: PRIMARY (prevention, not detection): ONE exported path/config RESOLVER (a single-source function) is imported by BOTH the gate AND the runtime consumer, so the gated-path and the runtime-loaded-path CANNOT diverge by construction. NOT a detector that notices they disagree — police-the-output has lost every campaign instance (R37.15/16/17 + no-flush all killed the generator/chokepoint, never policed the output).

The fix must make divergence UNREPRESENTABLE, not merely detectable: a same-named sibling in another dir, a pre-build copy, or a default that differs from the deploy/load path are all FORBIDDEN because both sides resolve through the ONE function. A design that relies on a detector noticing the mismatch has already failed this AC.

STUB-MUST-FAIL divergence BITE: plant a DIVERGENCE between the gated-path and the runtime-loaded-path (e.g. gate checks fileX while runtime loads fileY, the R40.34-L1 shape) -> the guard MUST go RED. Proves the single-source prevention is LIVE, not assumed. A guard that cannot fail on a planted divergence certifies nothing.

WRONG-ARTIFACT is DISTINCT from stale-gate (R37.17 = the product's shape changed; staleness eventually REDs) and wrong-SURFACE (gate-the-AC-surface = tests the abandoned surface). Wrong-artifact = the gate certifies a file the runtime never loads = GREEN-FOREVER, never self-REDs = the worst of the three (nothing surfaces it but a manual audit).

R40.34-L1 is the FIRST application: both check:revoked-tokens AND the server's REVOKED_TOKENS_PATH resolve the revoked list via the ONE resolver (RevokedTokens.unifyLoadPath) — the live divergence (gate=revoked-token-hashes.json ROOT / server=data/revoked-tokens.json DATA_DIR) becomes unrepresentable once both import the single source.
